subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “Mark bought a snow globe at a second-hand shop.”?
options: "That was the first movie your mother and I watched together," he said.
She was upset because she used it for messages, homework photos, and music.
The school made a new rule: students could not use phones during lunch.
When homework made him tired, he shook it and watched the snow fall.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「'That was the first movie your mother and I watched together,' he said.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「She was upset because she used it for messages, homework photos, and music.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The school made a new rule: students could not use phones during lunch.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「When homework made him tired, he shook it and watched the snow fall.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「When homework made him tired, he shook it and watched the snow fall.」，答案為「When homework made him tired, he shook it and watched the snow fall.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「When homework made him tired, he shook it and watched the snow fall.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
